headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2022: Penta Oscuro made their AEW debut, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.59.
It was 2024 when Action Andretti stepped back through the curtain after just under 2 months away, appearing on Rampage.
On this day in 2022, it was the first-ever encounter between Bryan Danielson and Daniel Garcia, in the show-closing main event slot on Dynamite, rated 7.32 ? a strong outing.

secondaries.text: Back on this day in 2022, The Butcher stepped back through the curtain after just over 3 months away, appearing on Dynamite.
On a Friday in 2024, back when Jake Hager returned to the fold after 6 weeks away, appearing on Rampage.
